info.title: SYNTRIASS SIEPMU demonstration API
info.description: Synthetic demonstrator contract; TLS required beyond loopback. Auth/device proof, grant, object submit/prepare/claim/ACK, current control and admin policy have explicit request/response schemas exercised over real HTTP. Remaining routes are marked inventory/auth-guard only. Device binding and operation proof are additional authorization requirements, not additional HTTP credential headers. Cryptographic verification, policy eligibility and cross-field time/hash relationships are runtime checks, not proved by JSON Schema.

BearerSession.description: Opaque 15-minute session, memory-only client; possession alone does not authorize device-bound mutations.

Signature.description: Unpadded base64url, 64-byte IEEE P1363 ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 signature.

token.description: Opaque bearer session; never persist in browser storage.

Ciphertext.description: Unpadded base64url AES-GCM ciphertext including tag; 16 through 1,048,592 decoded bytes. Hash, canonical encoding and decoded length are checked at runtime.

RequestId.description: Server-generated request UUID, supplied on every control API response. JSON errors repeat exactly this value as requestId; an incoming value is not trusted.

Error.description: JSON error with stable code and request correlation. No stack trace or secret material.
